tool_input.command:
bash -c '
WORKSPACE_ROOT="/home/rizz/dev/os-manager"
validate_skill_frontmatter() {
    local skill_dir="${WORKSPACE_ROOT}/.claude/skills"
    local invalid_count=0
    local count=0

    for skill_file in "${skill_dir}"/*/SKILL.md; do
        [ -f "${skill_file}" ] || continue
        count=$((count + 1))

        # Check begins with "---"
        local first_line
        first_line="$(head -n 1 "${skill_file}")"
        if [ "${first_line}" != "---" ]; then
            echo "  [ERROR] ${skill_file}: does not start with ---" >&2
            invalid_count=$((invalid_count + 1))
            continue
        fi

        # Extract frontmatter block between line 1 and the next "---"
        local end_line
        end_line="$(awk "NR>1 && /^---$/ {print NR; exit}" "${skill_file}")"
        if [ -z "${end_line}" ]; then
            echo "  [ERROR] ${skill_file}: missing closing --- delimiter" >&2
            invalid_count=$((invalid_count + 1))
            continue
        fi

        local frontmatter
        frontmatter="$(sed -n "2,$((end_line - 1))p" "${skill_file}")"

        # Check name: field exists
        if ! echo "${frontmatter}" | grep -qE "^name:\s*.+"; then
            echo "  [ERROR] ${skill_file}: missing or empty \"name:\" field in frontmatter" >&2
            invalid_count=$((invalid_count + 1))
            continue
        fi

        # Check description: field exists
        if ! echo "${frontmatter}" | grep -qE "^description:\s*.+"; then
            echo "  [ERROR] ${skill_file}: missing or empty \"description:\" field in frontmatter" >&2
            invalid_count=$((invalid_count + 1))
            continue
        fi

        # Check description starts with "Use when" or "You MUST use this"
        local desc_val
        desc_val="$(echo "${frontmatter}" | grep -E "^description:" | head -n 1 | sed -E "s/^description:[[:space:]]*//" | sed -E "s/^[\"'\''']//")"
        if [[ ! "${desc_val}" =~ ^(Use when|You MUST use this) ]]; then
            echo "  [ERROR] ${skill_file}: description does not begin with \"Use when\" or \"You MUST use this\" (got: ${desc_val})" >&2
            invalid_count=$((invalid_count + 1))
            continue
        fi
    done

    if [ "${count}" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "  [ERROR] No skills found in ${skill_dir}" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    return "${invalid_count}"
}

validate_skill_frontmatter
echo "Validation returned: $?"
'

results.snippet: Changelog resmi PipeWire 1.6 vs 1.4: Menghadirkan SPA loop locking dengan priority inversion (menggantikan epoll/eventfd untuk konkurensi data-thread), default 3 periods pada Pro-Audio mode untuk memangkas latency driver ALSA/Firewire, optimasi convolver/resampler fixed-point math, penegakan node.exclusive/port.exclusive, serta default.clock.quantum-floor konfigurabel.

Changelog WirePlumber 0.5.x: Optimasi stream linking tanpa full graph rescan guna mengurangi audio startup latency dan beban CPU, penambahan prioritas graph driver pada ALSA nodes dalam pro-audio profile, serta integrasi scheduling realtime untuk bluetooth nodes.

Analisis penjadwalan real-time PipeWire dan kernel Linux 6.12 (PREEMPT_DYNAMIC/PREEMPT_RT): Perbandingan mekanisme rlimits (SCHED_FIFO 88) vs RTKit (ceiling prio 20) untuk eliminasi XRuns pada buffer quantum rendah (64/128) dan memlock audio buffers.

Panduan dan benchmark penentuan quantum buffer PipeWire (64, 128, 256, 512): Analisis period budget latensi round-trip pada 48kHz/96kHz, stabilitas pemrosesan DSP, dampak jitter USB polling, serta trade-off headroom CPU vs zero-XRun reliability.

Rilis PipeWire 1.4: Baseline arsitektur penyatuan konfigurasi realtime (client.conf dengan RT priority default), perbaikan antrean invoke multithread, dukungan UMP/MIDI 2.0, serta optimasi buffer delay reporting pada modul audio.

Ikhtisar fitur PipeWire 1.6: Menjaga kompatibilitas ABI/API dengan rilis 1.4, peningkatan batas saluran hingga 128 audio channels, peningkatan parser POD memori bersama (shared memory safety), dan modul filter-graph DSP baru.

results.snippet: Details omarchy-shell architecture: a unified long-running Quickshell process running on Hyprland that manages desktop panels, bar widgets, plugin registry, IPC messaging, and modular QML plugins.

Enumerates Omarchy's core package manifest (omarchy-base.packages), including the Hyprland Wayland compositor, uwsm session manager, Waybar/Quickshell, Walker launcher, Foot terminal, Starship prompt, and modern CLI utils (bat, eza, ripgrep, fd, zoxide).

Documents Omarchy's developer toolchain and omarchy-install-dev-env architecture, utilizing mise for polyglot runtime management (Ruby, Node, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Elixir) alongside uv, rustup, and containerized dev databases.
